doc:
Subscription module for the MySocial network
 Handles subscription services for profiles & MyData

create_profile_service.doc: Create a subscription service container for a profile (called by profile owner)

create_profile_service_entry.doc: Entry function to create and share a profile subscription service

create_subscription_plan.doc: Create a sellable plan on a profile subscription service (profile owner only).

update_subscription_plan.doc: Update an existing plan (profile owner only).

deactivate_subscription_plan.doc: Deactivate a plan so it no longer accepts new subscriptions (profile owner only).

subscribe_to_profile.doc: Subscribe to a profile plan with optional auto-renewal (no platform fee recipient).

subscribe_to_profile_with_platform.doc: Subscribe to a profile plan with platform treasury routing for the platform-fee slice.

renew_subscription_with_platform.doc: Manually renew a subscription with platform treasury routing.

auto_renew_subscription.doc: Gas-optimized auto-renew using pre-funded renewal balance (no platform).

auto_renew_subscription_with_platform.doc: Gas-optimized auto-renew with platform treasury routing.

can_auto_renew.doc: Check if subscription is eligible for auto-renewal without expensive operations

fund_renewal_balance.doc: User funds their renewal balance for auto-renewal

is_subscription_valid.doc: Check if a subscription is valid for access

service_profile_owner.doc: Profile owner for a subscription service (for cross-module gate checks).

service_is_active.doc: Whether the service accepts new subscriptions.

is_subscription_valid_for.doc: Whether `subscriber` holds a valid subscription to `service` at `clock`.

subscription_satisfies_access.doc: Whether subscription satisfies optional tier and platform constraints for content access.

cancel_subscription.doc: Cancel subscription and get refund of unused renewal balance

create_subscription_admin_cap.doc: Create a SubscriptionAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)

SubscriptionPlan.doc: Sellable plan on a profile subscription service.

ProfileSubscriptionService.doc: Profile subscription service - one per profile, holds multiple plans

profile_owner.doc: Profile owner who receives subscription fees

profile_id.doc: Profile object this service belongs to

plans.doc: Active and inactive plans keyed by plan id

plan_count.doc: Number of plans ever created on this service

active.doc: Whether this service allows new subscriptions

service_id.doc: The profile service this subscription is for

tier_level.doc: Tier copied from plan at purchase time

platform_id.doc: Platform scope copied from plan at purchase time

expires_at.doc: When the subscription expires (timestamp in ms)

renewal_count.doc: Number of times this subscription has been renewed

ProfileSubscriptionServiceCreatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a subscription service is created

RenewalBalanceFundedEvent.doc: Event emitted when renewal balance is funded

ProfileSubscriptionServiceDeactivatedEve.doc: Event emitted when a subscription service is deactivated
